title: MT61303: Principles Of Iron Making
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Iron ores and their processing. Agglomeration of Iron ores : Sintering and
Palletizing, Technology and Agglomeration, Science of Agglomeration, Heat and
mass transfer effects, Economics of Agglomeration, Advantages and Disadvantages
of using pellets in the burden. Blast Furnance Iron making : An Assessment of
the technology, Charge material and the charging device, Distribution of burden
in the blast furnace, The various âzonesâ inside the furnace and the role
played by them in the iron making process. The physical chemistry of blast
furnace reaction, Mathematical modeling of blast furnace. Transport phenomena
of blast furnace process, Recent innovations, Solid injection through tuyers,
Technological status of blast furnace operation control. Slag-metal reactions
in blast furnace, Ionic theory of slag. Alternate iron making processes. A
detailed survey of the major available processes.
